title: Google Research IMP/MAX: Locked Dataclass Config Governance, Registry Binding & Hierarchical Overrides
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject imp in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); NeurIPS 2023 / arXiv:2305.06324
Shares typed Python configuration & registry discipline across Google repos

claims.assertion: validators.lock and validators.validate inspect typing.get_type_hints() on dataclass subclasses against _ATTRIBUTES_BASE_CLS, rejecting undeclared attributes and incompatible types while optionally allowing Optional/Union narrowing via unwrap_types=True.
Registrar maintains dual _CONFIG_REGISTRY and _CLASS_REGISTRY maps keyed by config.name with duplicate-overwrite protection unless overwrite=True.
Config provides copy_and_override(), list-index path overrides, YAML export(), and class-level lock_attributes()/get_attribute_lock() hooks.

distilled_learning: Lock base dataclass schemas with attribute-set and type-hint validators (@validators.lock/@validators.validate) paired with duplicate-checked config-to-class Registrar mappings so experiment variants cannot silently diverge on typos.
